text: maria-ops: heads up — several customers reported 'payment received' but the invoice PDFs we sent out are missing the billing address block and PO number. started when webhook retries spiked this morning. cc @alex-finance stripe-webhook-bot: webhook_event=invoice.payment_succeeded id=evt_3KZ... status=delivered attempts=1 alex-finance: saw 4 cases so far. external accounting rejects the PDF because no PO and no tax block. customers show balance 0 in console though. any correlation id or ledger id? maria-ops: examples: cust_acct=redact-201, invoice_id=inv_2026_887, ledger_tx=ltx_9a3. attached payload snippet below — note invoice_metadata.po_number is present in the webhook payload but the rendered PDF has an empty po field. sam-engineering: can you paste the raw webhook body? we pushed a change to the invoice renderer yesterday that touched address templating. worried about a NPE fallback that strips lines. maria-ops: paste below: ``` { "id": "evt_3KZ...", "type": "invoice.payment_succeeded", "data": { "object": { "id": "inv_2026_887", "metadata": { "po_number": "PO-12345", "legal_entity": "Acme Ltd" }, "billing_details": { "address": { "line1": "123 Market St", "city": "SF", "postal_code": "94103", "country": "US" } } } } } ``` julia-qa: repro notes — if renderer receives billing_details.address as null it falls back to company default. But here address exists. I grabbed our generated HTML for inv_2026_887 and saw the po placeholder is an empty string: ``. Renderer logic reads payload.metadata.po_number and then runs a sanitize() helper that treats certain unicode dashes as missing and returns empty. Could be our sanitize regex accidentally marking 'PO-12345' as invalid. sam-engineering: typing quick fix: sanitize() was updated to strip non-alphanumeric but didn't allow hyphens. pushing a patch to allow `-` and `_` in metadata tokens. will deploy to staging, please QA. ingest-bot: noticed a duplicate webhook delivered for evt_3KZ... attempts=2 with http_status=200, body_length=14ms latency spike at 08:12:05. signature verified. alex-finance: separate thread — one customer had a card_declined earlier today for a renewal. payment gateway retried and then succeeded, but our invoice generation happened on the first failed attempt, produced an unpaid invoice PDF and emailed it, then not updated after success. we should re-render on final success. maria-ops: agreed. current flow triggers PDF render on webhook receipt, not on status transition. that's how stale unpaid PDFs appear. sam-engineering: plan: (1) fix sanitize regex and redeploy renderer (2) make invoice render idempotent: re-render on invoice.payment_succeeded when status changed to paid and send update (3) add a background job to re-render invoices where gateway status != PDF status for last 24h. I'll open a PR. julia-qa: I'll run regression for international addresses and VAT fields — previous fixes caused line-break issues in EU addresses. will validate sample CSV of 25 accounts (DE/FR/UK) and include PO formats with unicode dashes. alex-finance: operational asks: add a reconciliation flag in the emails so accounting vendors see "revised" versions, and include original invoice id + payment tx id. can we put that in the PDF header instead of changing filename? customers don't want duplicate emails. sam-engineering: yes — add a small banner `REVISED` and append ` — payment: ltx_9a3` under invoice meta. low-risk change. maria-ops: for immediate remediation, can support manually trigger re-render for affected invoices? we need a quick tool. sam-engineering: exposing a one-click re-render endpoint in internal console — auth gated. I'll scope and ship in a hotfix, ETA 2h. ingest-bot: metric alert: invoice-render-errors spiked to 37 in last 10m, top error message: "Invalid metadata token". alex-finance: please add the four customer ids to the hotfix re-render queue once deployed and send me the revised PDFs so I can notify accounting. maria-ops: list: redact-201, blueco-77, financehub-5, orbiter-corp. thanks all. :pray: sam-engineering: PR opened: GH-3124. patch fixes sanitize, adds hyphen allowlist, added re-render-on-paid hook, and a temporary admin re-render endpoint. will deploy to prod after smoke. julia-qa: smoke passed on staging for US/EU/UK samples. manual PDF diff shows PO now present and VAT block preserved. lifting staging hold. maria-ops: deployed and re-rendered the four invoices.Alex, sending revised PDFs via secure share now. alex-finance: got them. sending to customers with short note explaining revised invoice after post-payment update. closing loop with accounting. thanks team. :white_check_mark: maria-ops: filing an incident postmortem with timeline and recommended guardrails (re-render on status change, metadata validation unit tests, more webhook retry handling). assigning to sam for remediation items and julia for QA checklist. stripe-webhook-bot: alert cleared for evt_3KZ..., latency normalized. julia-qa: I'll add PO format fuzzing to our CI so odd unicode chars don't slip through. sam-engineering: creating follow-up tickets: INF-227 (re-render policy), INF-228 (metadata validation and sanitize tests), INF-229 (admin re-render audit log). maria-ops: thanks everyone. closing thread once tickets are linked in the PM.
